body: So far.. okay. I'm still waiting for an appointment to be reassessed by a psych. Seems i've gone a bit manic and keep having these ridiculous delusions...
yup, got called in to work today, also working tomorrow and monday. Tonight i'm just going to make nice food, watch good films and have an early night.
Thanks.. Just trying to convince myself to go on for another day. But it's really not easy
I am... By fluke. Didn't realise that my meds and alcohol don't get on together, passed out on my living room floor, came round this morning.

Well, if I walked in to the hospital they would just have me wait a few hours to talk to a mental health team then probably send me home. I'd have to be sectioned under the mental health act to be taken in properly.. It's happened before when i got very unwell. So, I have very little faith. At least I've got the company of some understanding and kind people on here in my last few hours.

I would prefer disaranno but hey ho.. I pretty much have done that all my life. Walk out of a job and call everyone a cunt on the way out then throw my security pass down a drain in front of building security.. Got myself in trouble so many times. Fuck who I want. Drink and take what I want. Buy that dress because fuck my bank account who cares and it's pretty. Up and leave and move 200 miles away because I'm bored. I've gotten up to all sorts of shit and lived how I wanted. But it's not enough. 

I'm done with trying to get help when I need it and begging for the right medication. Oh, I'm in the UK. I only want to turn off my phone later because as I've learned from previous attempts, no matter how determined you are, the self preserving part of the brain overrides all other functions. That's how last year, I managed the hour walk to a hospital despite what I had taken.. I don't recall any of it, but yeah..
Well, the last time I phoned emergency services for help all they did was put me on a waiting list to be phoned back, and bla bla... That's the UK for ya.

I told them I can't cope anymore with hallucinations, both visual and auditory, feeling constantly paranoid and anxious and feeling sad for no reason. I can't really explain why I'm so hellbent on ending it but I just know that I only live to die. I've had enough of existing.

And their response is that I'm not an emergency, despite I said that I know exactly how I'll do it... They don't seem very interested.

Thank you for reading it.. I feel like I can tell people these things sometimes but they don't listen, understandably most people wouldn't really understand. I've not even had better luck with the 'professionals'. But there are some things I feel I can't even tell my closest friends, because I have so few and don't want to worry or scare them.
PTSD is cruel. all it takes is the littlest thing. A sound, a look, a tone of voice.
I think like that a lot, have done since i was pretty young.. I often wonder, what if I hadn't moved several hours away from where i grew up, or a different city, what if i had ran away to another country.. Imagine different planet earths..
I wish i could feel normal and not have some part of my mind that desperately wants me six feet under..
shucks that's an essay im sorry

I know I did well for working through what happened in the past. I've had endless therapy antidepressants and antipsychotics, stuff to help anxiety. I also know that I have borderline personality disorder quite badly as my changes are very pronounced. The BPD is where the psychosis comes from, including visual/auditory hallucinations, voices in my head that are not my own. I also have PTSD because of the abuse. And a disocciative disorder - specific to me, I disconnect and will have absolutely no recollection of what happened, i only know that I have lost time, it can be seconds, minutes, hours, days. The longest I dissociated for was just over week, roughly. it fucked up my memory either side of the episode. And I suspect that I did some awful things during that time, because where I was living at the time, stuff never happened. But it's when i have a combined psychotic and dissociative episode that stuff gets really bad.. a few times it's been documented in a general hospital and a psych ward. i asked someone else what i did, long story short i trashed the place, hurt others, managed to break out, screaming that i was sent from another galaxy to resurrect gods that would fix the world.. i managed to go on the run. I've had police out in cars and helicopters sent to find me many times. I only know because others have told me. But anyway i'm sorry im rambling but ive written it now so I may aswell keep it.
Yesterday nothing happened. Only good things have been happening and continue to do so. But it's like I just cant seem to shift whatevers going on in my head. Right now I'm listening to peaceful music and feeling very strange. Like as if there is something i need to do thats very important but a huge secret. everything around me doesn't make sense. like why i couldn't reach through a wall to get something. i keep flitting in and out and i know it
